jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Manager Information Technology to join our Design Eng Processes team
- CAT IT Division. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule. Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST Job Purpose: Your Work Shapes the World. Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 95-year legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe. When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. We don’t just talk about progress and innovation. We make it happen. And we are proud of that because it helps our customers build and power the world we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customer’s needs. Join us. The Information Technology Manager role has ownership of the main support and execute functions for the Enterprise Applications department within Caterpillar IT. This includes accountability for support metrics, management of contracts with strategic vendors, and leadership over a global Caterpillar team responsible for the delivery of these services. The application portfolio in question includes multiple instances of SAP, Manufacturing, Order to Delivery and pricing applications, among others. This is a critical role that helps ensure our end users experience a well-equipped, efficient, and simple touchpoint to support. Further, this role owns the Continuous Improvement journey for the department, with programs that drive toward improving automation, monitoring, and analytic capabilities. Job Duties: Own and drive all incidents, service tasks, problem tickets and system optimization for operations portfolio, ensuring delivery against commitments, SLAs, and outcomes. Establish, monitor, and continuously improve standard work; ensure progress, risks, and dependencies are communicated effectively to stakeholders and leadership. Manage and develop a multi-disciplinary organization delivering business and technical solutions, including process functionality, technical capability, and automation. Partner with business units and decision makers to support day-to-day operations, incident/problem resolution, and continuous service improvement. Implement and govern common operating procedures, controls, and metrics to strengthen quality, compliance, and operational resilience. Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing IT teams, foster a collaborative and results-oriented work environment. Execute multiple priorities & business requirements. Develops solutions that best meet the needs of the enterprise, with options to meet differentiated business capabilities as needed. Develops & manages IT budget for area of accountability. Delivers highly available, leading IT services through best-in-class service level management practices with the ability to flex with changing business demands. What You Will Have: Organizational Leadership: Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives. Functional and/or Technical SAP knowledge Gen AI Assisted Development or Support: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as Git Hub Copilot or automated agent workflows) to accelerate application development or support, cost or effort reduction, or support optimization. Demonstrated experience with AI tools Experience managing contracts and vendor relationships A Lean or Continuous Improvement background. An ability to translate between technical and business language, creating a bridge between the support organization and the Caterpillar business they serve. Experience as a leader in the IT space. Top candidates will also have: Has the ability to lead, analyze and have a broader perspective on specific technology and related solutions. This requires a comprehensive understanding of application solutions, interfaces, security, data governance policies and procedures. Skilled in large scale application support and development Prior experience in driving innovation and automation Extensive experience in working with cross-functional teams, along with proven history of strong job-related result's Execute business objectives through collaboration and decisive action. Provide guidance to the team in resolving issues in a timely manner and lead technical teams with focus on innovation and continuous improvement. Lead and/or direct teams within or outside of discipline addressing complex problems. Experience in managing teams working across multiple locations working from satellite office location's Strong stakeholder management skills People Leadership / Scope Directly lead IT Managers, Technology Specialists, Information Systems Specialists, Business Managers, and application/technical/operations teams within the division; drive performance management, coaching, succession planning, and a culture of collaboration and accountability. Additional Duties Perform other related duties as assigned to support organizational objectives. Education/Experience: Requires a relevant computer science masters or graduate degree and 15 plus years of progressively complex Information Service experience including staff and supervisory assignments in Information Services and related areas. Requires general understanding of basic business operations including one or more of the following: general business processes, technical infrastructure, application development and support of major projects, and engineering functional applications. The incumbent must have ability to provide strategic direction for effectively managing staff, budgets, business plans, project plans and developing 2-5-year plans on Information Services. Requires ability to work with diversified departments along with effective oral and written communications skills. The incumbent must have a strong customer focus and business knowledge. The position also requires to work efficiently with integration partners, technology vendors, and managed service partners. Additional Info: May require travel of up to 25% This role requires 5 days onsite. Relocation is unavailable. Skill Descriptors Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge: • Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals. • Communicates key considerations for business decision making process. • Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions. • Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area. • Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities. Information Technology Trends: Knowledge of marketplace experience, developments and trends related to the organization's use of Information Technology (IT); ability to apply knowledge of IT appropriately to benefit the organization. Level Expert: • Participates in architecting an enterprise-wide technology strategy. • Champions awareness of criticality of IT to business, staying with IT trends as needs dictate. • Ensures senior management awareness of enterprise-wide impact of major technology trends . • Monitors industry experience and best practices on IT trends and introducing new technology. • Provides perspective on the evolution and impact of major technologies. • Analyzes organization's transition and support strategies. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Expert: • Monitors industry trends and directions and discusses possible impact on internal strategies. • Designs and orchestrates the use of business analytics for strategic decision making. • Champions the use of business intelligence applications for tactical and strategic decisions. • Helps others discover the diverse features, parameters, or considerations to take into account. • Implements operating metrics and performance gauges such as the balanced scorecard. • Employs statistical and quantitative analysis, explanatory and predictive modeling techniques. Continuous Transformation: Knowledge of evolving the business to remain competitive; ability to understand, adapt oneself to, respond to and proactively seek changes and innovation in the business environment to improve the competitive advantage of an organization. Level Working Knowledge: • Implements new systems, procedures and tools efficiently when changes occur in the work environment. • Adjusts current working processes or adopts new approaches in response to changes in the business environment. • Seeks challenging opportunities or assignments to grow and develop one's own knowledge, skills and abilities. • Explains lessons or experiences learned from mistakes and failures as well as successes. • Communicates and analyzes assumptions about a particular issue with colleagues to gain new perspectives or more effective solutions. Talent Management: Knowledge of the critical competencies required to achieve intended results; ability to generate consistent approaches for hiring, selection, retaining and leveraging talent across the organization. Level Extensive Experience: • Promotes a talent-focused organization where talent management is the responsibility of all managers. • Develops a consistent set of practices that build a pipeline of future leaders for key positions. • Directs mentoring and coaching programs to reinforce learning and development and to surface candidates for selection and succession. • Creates a specific employee value proposition to improve the retention and motivation of team members. • Offers key developmental and transitional experiences to those one is mentoring or coaching. • Develops clear criteria and guidelines for determining optimal fit between individuals and key roles. Leadership: Knowledge of leadership practices and processes; ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives while having a long-term perspective of the future state of things and how to get there. Level Expert: • Evaluates leader performance based on efficacy, advancement and emergence. • Coaches others in leadership concepts and techniques, such as contingency & transactional. • Champions behaviors that inspire cohesiveness and move the organization to reach a vision. • Monitors industry for leadership programs; implements programs within organization. • Leverages diverse leadership styles: autocratic for speed, democratic for co-operation, etc. • Uses modeling & role-playing to improve the ability of leaders to manage own behaviors. Matrix Management: Understanding of the importance of being able to leverage external resources when required and ability to build and use effective working relationships within own department and across department, functional, and geographic reporting lines. Level Working Knowledge: • Communicates effectively up, down, and across the organization. • Balances requirements and deliverables from various functional areas. • Describes basic viewpoint of own functional specialty. • Under guidance, identifies and resolves potentially conflicting requirements. • Keeps relevant functional and line associates involved on key project or tactical issues. Vendor/Supplier Management: Knowledge of external provider management processes and ability to effectively manage the business relationship with external providers (e.g. vendors, service providers, contractors, consultants and suppliers). Level Expert: • Leads a team in managing collaborative relationships with multiple vendors or suppliers. • Provides comprehensive knowledge of industry practices with using external or third parties. • Evaluates vendor or supplier's plans and directions and potential impact on the organization. • Develops rationale and best practices for use of external vendor/supplier resources. • Shares experiences with managing and integrating products and services from multiple vendors or suppliers. • Consults on service provider problems and corrects or terminates as appropriate. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. Relocation assistance Holistic Development Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe Career developments opportunities with global prospects Health and Wellness Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage Employee mental wellness assistance program Financial Wellness Employee investment plan Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan. Additional Information: Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities
- are encouraged to apply. This position requires working onsite five days a week. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates: Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community. There’s more to work at Caterpillar than just the work itself. We hire smart, friendly people and it shows in our culture. We hold ourselves to high standards and make sure our values of integrity, excellence, teamwork, commitment and sustainability come to life in the way we work. We make sure our employees feel continuously challenged while also supported. We provide professional growth opportunities, including leadership programs. We celebrate the diversity of our team, while also working together as one Caterpillar. Our culture, like everything at our company, is made possible by each employee’s contribution. Person by person, we create the environment we work in, and we are proud of the Caterpillar we’ve built.

jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Definition Assists in the design, definition, development, and test of the robotics software development; collaborates with senior engineers to ensure that internal and external clients' needs are met. Responsibilities • Collecting and researching data on customer experience with robotic platforms; preparing reports for management. • Documenting architecture specifications, software design description, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures. • Utilizing appropriate tools to debug, test and maintain software and hardware systems of robotic tools; assisting in the verification and validation process. • Participating in design and development of application software and algorithms for robotic platforms. • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Degree Requirement Degree required Skill Descriptors Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the organization's industry group, trends, directions, major issues, regulatory considerations, and trendsetters; ability to apply industry knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: • Educates others on own organization in terms of the industry
- its market position, niche (if any), etc.. • Compares and contrasts the latest developments and emerging issues in the industry. • Raises coworkers' awareness of industry standards, practices and guidelines. • Assesses how regulatory and reporting requirements apply to own organization. • Explains the development of industry segments
- trends, consequences, key issues. • Discusses industry-specific cycles and associated considerations. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort. • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts. • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate. • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes. • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies. • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems. Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. Level Extensive Experience: • Explains how to use multiple, vendor-provided or in-house structured methodologies. • Describes tasks, tools and practices for converting software product requirements into a design. • Demonstrates experience with all phases and deliverables of the product development methodology. • Implements the generic functions, features and facilities of modern structured methods. • Explores and evaluates major structured methodologies available in the marketplace. • Consults on effective application of structured product development methodologies. Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements. Level Extensive Experience: • Has experience with planning and executing full spectrum of tests for multiple products. • Provides input to design team to ensure testing considerations are incorporated into system design. • Creates test scenarios that ensure all error handling processes perform as expected. • Defines, creates, and executes test plans and cases; estimates time, effort and resources required. • Explains approaches and tools for functional, reliability, and vulnerability testing. • Discusses applications of iterative testing using agile methodologies. Application Development Tools: Knowledge of application and system development; ability to utilize a variety of specific tools and toolkits for developing applications. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates toolkits used to support major production systems. • Resolves issues regarding functions, features and components of multiple toolkits. • Provides implementation support on toolkit enhancements or changes. • Interprets benefits and drawbacks of procedural and event-driven toolkits. • Oversees the evaluation and recommendation of delivery tools and platforms. • Coaches others on appropriate uses of all major tools in a toolkit for a specific platform. Artificial Intelligence: Knowledge of the concepts, technologies and methodologies of artificial intelligence (AI); ability to develop, implement and/or apply artificial intelligence products and services in specific industry domain to achieve business goals. Level Working Knowledge: • Performs basic tasks within a specific artificial intelligence area, such as self-driving cars, medical diagnosis, playing games, financial fraud detection, etc. • Assists in business requirements analysis in the AI solution design or deployment process. • Maintains and/or updates AI systems and equipment on a regular basis. • Deploys, develops or operates specific AI products, equipment, systems and/or platforms to achieve certain business goals. • Tests and troubleshoots the functionality of AI applications and systems within a specific area. Programming: Knowledge of relevant programming languages and tools; ability to test, write, design, debug, troubleshoot and maintain source codes and computer programs. Level Extensive Experience: • Conducts walkthroughs and monitors the quality of development activities. • Assesses the impact of new productivity improvement tools on one's own area of responsibility. • Compares and contrasts similarities and differences between multiple programming languages. • Oversees major developmental efforts adhering to application systems design. • Evaluates characteristics and advantages of different programming techniques. • Coaches juniors on multiple programming languages. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Extensive Experience: • Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future. • Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness. • Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments. • Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions. • Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems. • Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients. title: Manager Software Engineering - Azure Integration
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. The Software Engineering Manager leads multiple engineering teams responsible for delivering enterprise-scale integration solutions, APIs, and dealer deployment capabilities across Caterpillar's digital ecosystem. This role combines people leadership, technical governance, delivery execution, and strategic stakeholder management to ensure secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions aligned with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards. The position partners closely with Product Management, Architecture, Platform Engineering, Dealer Operations, and Business stakeholders to deliver predictable outcomes while building high-performing engineering teams and fostering continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Engineering Delivery & Execution Lead multiple software engineering teams delivering integration, platform, and dealer deployment initiatives. Own end-to-end delivery of assigned portfolio, ensuring alignment with Program Increment (PI) objectives, sprint commitments, and release milestones. Drive delivery predictability through planning, estimation, resource allocation, risk management, and dependency tracking. Monitor project execution, schedule performance, and operational readiness to ensure successful deployments. Establish and maintain delivery metrics, status reporting, and governance mechanisms. Technical Leadership & Architecture Provide technical direction for enterprise integration platforms, APIs, cloud-native applications, and distributed systems. Guide engineering teams in designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions leveraging Azure, .NET, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, and integration technologies. Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture principles, engineering standards, security requirements, and operational excellence practices. Conduct design reviews, architecture walkthroughs, and technical assessments to ensure long-term maintainability and reuse. Promote adoption of modern software development practices, tools, automation, and engineering innovation. Team Leadership & Talent Development Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Leads, Senior Engineers, and Software Engineers. Establish performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and career development support. Identify skill gaps and create development plans to strengthen technical and leadership capabilities. Support hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce management activities. Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and high-performing engineering culture. Integration Engineering & Platform Management Oversee development and support of enterprise integration solutions across internal and external platforms. Guide teams in API design, software integration, ETL/data movement processes, system interoperability, and cloud integration patterns. Ensure reliable integration between dealer systems, enterprise applications, cloud services, and business platforms. Support dealer rollout planning, deployment coordination, stabilization, and operational readiness activities. Software Development & Quality Management Ensure adherence to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices. Champion software quality through design reviews, testing strategies, automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. Establish measurable quality metrics and drive improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. Support Dev Ops adoption, CI/CD automation, and engineering productivity improvements. Stakeholder & Business Partnership Serve as the primary engineering partner for Product Management, Architecture, Release Management, Business stakeholders, and external partners. Communicate delivery plans, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to leadership and governance forums. Balance business priorities, technical debt, engineering capacity, and operational requirements. Influence strategic technology decisions beyond direct reporting relationships. Governance, Compliance & Operational Excellence Ensure compliance with enterprise policies related to security, change management, risk management, and operational readiness. Drive continuous improvement across development, deployment, support, and incident management processes. Establish engineering standards, governance frameworks, and operational KPIs. Promote IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices to improve service quality and operational effectiveness. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering leadership or people management roles. Proven track record leading multiple engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale software and integration solutions. Strong experience with: Microsoft Azure .NET / C# SQL Server Azure Integration Services APIs and Integration Platforms Microsoft Fabric and Data Lake technologies Deep understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, integration patterns, and cloud-native technologies. Expertise across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile delivery, Dev Ops, and release management practices. Experience managing globally distributed teams and vendor partnerships. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational leadership skills. Experience in large-scale B2B, dealer, supply chain, or enterprise platform environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Azure Integration Services (APIM, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Functions). Knowledge of event-driven architecture, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, data engineering, ETL/ELT, and analytics platforms. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates). Experience with Git Hub Enterprise, Azure Dev Ops, CI/CD platforms, and automated deployment frameworks. SAFe Agile, Scrum, Azure, or Cloud certifications. Prior experience supporting dealer ecosystems or large enterprise digital transformation initiatives. Posting Dates: September 28, 2026

Level Extensive Experience: • Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future. • Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness. • Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments. • Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions. • Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems. • Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Definition Solve challenging engineering problems involving products, systems, and components using advanced simulation techniques and analysis. Responsibilities • Collaborate with customers and leadership to scope and execute projects that meet the needs of the business • Model circuit/ wire routing, test bench setup as per CISPR, antenna, • Perform radiated/ conducted emission, immunity, coupling simulation • Performing board-level SI/PI & EMI/EMC simulation using ANSYS/CST tool • Perform structural and electrical simulations related to EV transmission system • Perform the analysis and suggest the design improvements to expert engineer for approval. • Meshing and Simulation for stiffness, strength and durability calculations of structural parts and assemblies under different loading conditions • Accountable for delivering timely, high-quality simulation and analysis impacting products/processes and providing clear recommendations to stakeholders • To provide the critical locations/ parameters to the Testing team for physical testing on track/ component level. • Keep up-to-date on new technologies and drive continuous improvement to established techniques • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Basic Knowledge • Must have experience in CST, HFSS, FEKO, LT Spice, PSpice tools, or equivalent • Must have experience in S-Parameter, Coupling simulations, PCB Conducted Emission Simulation, PCB Radiated Emission Simulation, RF pre-post layout simulations, EMI/EMC simulations
- RE, CE, RI, CI, ESD, EFT, Surge • Solid understanding of circuits and PCB layouts • Sound knowledge of Electromagnetics & TL theory, signal integrity, and power integrity • Knowledge of EMI/EMC certification standards • Experience in troubleshooting EMI issues with good knowledge of hardware design • Good in communication & ability to work well in a diverse, cross-functional, and global team Degree Requirement B. Tech/M. Tech in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical and Electronic Engineering from reputed Institute with atleast 8 to 10 years’ experience Skill Descriptors Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes. Level Working Knowledge: • Employs process flows, cycle time, process time and waste concepts as appropriate. • Walks through steps, decisions, measurements, dependencies and hand-offs for a specific process. • Creates process flow or work flow diagrams. • Documents types of process decisions and potential impact of each decision. • Identifies and monitors common process bottlenecks. Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge: • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights. • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs. • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy. • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned. • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge: • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance. • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions. • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns. • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand. • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge: • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort. • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts. • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate. • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes. • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies. • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems. Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Working Knowledge: • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components. • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services. • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence. • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues. Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives. Level Basic Understanding: • Identifies project management tools and requirements within own function. • Describes the key objectives, phases and deliverables of a current project. • Explains the concepts of phase, activity, task, and deliverable. • Gives examples of critical paths in projects. Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Knowledge of tools and techniques of specialized graphics programs; ability to produce, analyze, simulate and test product design drafts. Level Working Knowledge: • Generates specifications for parts or components with CAD software. • Reuses design components via reusable libraries following standard procedures. • Uses CAD to perform basic drafting such as wire frames, solid objects and array of objects. • Performs routine changes to computerized schematics or drawings. • Creates views of objects in 2 and 3 dimensions; creates perspective drawings and orthogonal views. There’s more to work at Caterpillar than just the work itself. We hire smart, friendly people and it shows in our culture. We hold ourselves to high standards and make sure our values of integrity, excellence, teamwork, commitment and sustainability come to life in the way we work. We make sure our employees feel continuously challenged while also supported. We provide professional growth opportunities, including leadership programs. We celebrate the diversity of our team, while also working together as one Caterpillar. Our culture, like everything at our company, is made possible by each employee’s contribution. Person by person, we create the environment we work in, and we are proud of the Caterpillar we’ve built.

title: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design Engineer
jobDescription: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Overview: The individual will be responsible for the Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design and development for our products. He / She should know and specialized in the PCB design tools to create schematic, layout, optimize designs for performance, to meet design requirements, specifications, manufacturability and ensure compliance with industry standards. Also, the individual collaborate with various engineering teams and requires strong understanding of electrical engineering principles, PCB fabrication, and assembly processes. Required Experience: 8Yr and above in the PCB domain. Responsibilities and Duties: Design and develop PCB layout which includes creating new design and modifying existing designs based on design team requirements and engineering specifications. Create and prepare PCB documentation like detailed schematics, layouts, fabrication, assembly drawings and other necessary documentation for PCB manufacturing and assembly. Generate Gerber and assembly files for PCB fabrication and assembly. Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) and ensure the PCB design meets industry standards and regulations for functionality and manufacturability. Collaborate with design team and engineers and work closely with electrical, mechanical, and other engineers to refine designs and resolve issues. Required Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field. Experience with PCB design software – Primary – Altium Designer, Secondary – Allegro /Or CAD. Strong foundation in basic electronics principles, including voltage, current, and impedance. Knowledge in PCB design principles, understanding of signal integrity, power distribution,thermal management, and relevant concepts. Experience in Analog, Digital, Mixed signal and High Voltage PCB designs. Understand the challenges in PCB design with both analog and digital circuits and implementing appropriate isolation and routing strategies. Experience in PCB Design with a minimum of 8 Layer and above. Knowledge in implementing strategies to reduce electromagnetic interference, such as shielding, filtering, and proper grounding. Knowledge in IPC standards, industry standards for PCB design and fabrication, such as IPC-2221, IPC-2152 and IPC-A-600. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. The ability to identify and resolve complex design issues. Provide with innovative ideas and technical advancements in PCB design and related activities. Knowledge in PCB manufacturing and assembly processes to ensure the design can be built and function as intended. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. The ability to work effectively with design engineers, team members and stakeholders.
minimumQualification: Knowledge in IPC standards, industry standards for ECAD library creation, such as IPC-7351. Knowledge in PCB simulation tools to analyse signal behaviour and identify potential issues like crosstalk, reflections, and impedance mismatches. Knowledge in high-speed signals PCB design, including techniques for minimizing signal degradation and EMI. Knowledge in PCB design translation from one ECAD tool to another ECAD tool. This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Posting Dates: Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Autonomy Project Team Lead
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Description Caterpillar’s Autonomous Mining Technologies is seeking an experienced Autonomy Project Team Lead to drive disciplined project execution and delivery of high-quality autonomy solutions. This role will streamline team workflows, strengthen Dev Ops and quality practices, coordinate validation, and build an effective, collaborative team. Own work planning, backlog execution, dependency management, and delivery tracking through Azure Dev Ops. Lead the autonomy project team, remove roadblocks, and maintain alignment to scope, schedule, quality, and business priorities. Work with global teams, streamline workflows, governance, reviews, metrics, and reporting to improve predictability and execution efficiency. Coordinate L4/L6 validation planning, readiness, resources, issue closure, and objective evidence across stakeholders. Drive Dev Ops, CI/CD, traceability, defect prevention, and continuous improvement practices. Identify project risks and process gaps; establish mitigation, contingency, and escalation plans. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Manager Digital Project (Finance Transformation Manager
- ITP) to join our COE-Accountable Reporting -Global Finance Services Division The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield, Bangalore-KA , India What you will do: As an integral part of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Center of Excellence, specifically focused on standardization, optimization and digitalization, the candidate will support the execution of our continuous improvement framework within the Global business service scope, with focus, but not exclusively, on the Invoice-to-Pay processes (ITP) Responsibilities may include, but are limited to: Drive continuous improvement activities including mapping current and future process maps, driving corrective actions, and developing, tracking, and measuring qualitative and quantitative results. Drive a culture of innovation, simplification and continuous improvement through best practice sharing, advocacy, and hands-on leadership. Partner with senior leadership, understand business goals, analyze opportunities, and develop improvement plans for various workflows/systems and technologies. Build roadmaps that support the tactical execution of key continuous improvement initiatives across stakeholder teams. Ensure consistent application of continuous improvement tools, methodologies, and best practices to accelerate improvements at scale. Identifies and engage subject matter experts in support of multi-functional efforts in continuous improvement. What you will have: Preferred previous consultancy experience (2-3 years)/overall experience 10 to 15 years Knowledge of best practices in invoice processing, supplier inquiry & helpdesk design, remittance advice issuance, vendor inquiries and dispute management Knowledge and understanding of the mechanics in the ITP process stream and how these fit into the end-to-end financial process environment. Project Management skills People leadership/management experience Diagnostic capabilities to identify improvement opportunities Ability to work effectively across a matrix environment and navigate without a formal authority to deliver on business results MSc/MBA in a scientific or business discipline Accounting certification or an equivalent combination of related experience Working knowledge of financial systems (SAP, QAD, etc) and ITP specific tools (e.g. OCR, Supplier Portals, Invoice Workflow tools) This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Skills desired: Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Extensive Experience: • Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks. • Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process. • Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact. • Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives. • Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus. • Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions. Organizational Leadership: Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives. Level Extensive Experience: • Employs various group decision-making methods depending on the situation. • Promotes efficacy through monitoring, coaching & motivating subordinates, intervention, etc. • Translates vision into specific functional or departmental initiatives. • Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes. • Uses a normative decision model (with leadership styles and situational variables) to select style. • Initiates structure: role clarification, setting standards, holding subordinates accountable, etc. Program Management (M0260): Knowledge of the policies and techniques to manage a set of related projects within a program; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control the set of projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve program objectives. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates risks and vulnerabilities, and creates contingency plans. • Advises others on preferred tools, techniques and methods for estimating program cost and time. • Conducts regular and ad-hoc program reviews with project managers, team and clients. • Coaches others in maintaining open communication among project managers and interested parties. • Oversees reporting requirements, and creates monitoring and control mechanisms. • Plans, estimates, staffs, organizes and monitors a set of projects within a program. Change Control: Knowledge of the processes and procedures by which a change is identified, evaluated, approved, monitored and documented; Ability to manage changes in the production environment and processes effectively+ Level Extensive Experience: • Train others in how to review a proposed change and assesses the potential impact of the change on the organization or environment. • Manages change control processes to ensure each change is evaluated and dispositioned at the proper authority level. • Oversees the development of organizational change management policies and procedures. • Develops and publishes comprehensive change and contingency plans. • Defines and communicates change risks, contingency alternatives and associated benefits and drawbacks. • Coordinates the implementation of change in diverse and complex production environments. IT Project Control and Reporting: Knowledge of project control and reporting; ability to monitor the vital signs of an IT project while managing its progress and delivery schedule. Level Extensive Experience: • Justifies varying and appropriate levels of scrutiny for differently experienced team members. • Advises on the selection of tools and techniques used for monitoring progress and presenting reports to stakeholders. • Communicates with managerial, technical and business stakeholders on progress reporting. • Controls multiple IT projects: monitoring progress, probing and repairing delays. • Consolidates the progress of many IT projects into a single progress report. • Consults on the principles of Earned Value Analysis across multiple IT projects. IT Project Management: Knowledge of project management; ability to plan, organize, monitor and control IT projects using appropriate technical resources. Level Extensive Experience: • Controls quality standards and budgeting in an ongoing IT project. • Estimates and appropriately addresses potential issues and risks in IT projects. • Ensures that technical objectives and functional requirements align in all IT projects. • Builds IT related templates for demand analysis and functional reports. • Monitors every step in an IT project to ensure all aspects of the project are delivered on-time. • Directs team members in analyzing client requirements in an appropriate manner. IT Standards, Procedures & Policies: Knowledge of Information Technology (IT) standards and policies; ability to utilize a variety of administrative skill sets and technical knowledge to manage organizational IT policies, standards, and procedures. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates the effectiveness of IT policies through professional group discussions. • Designs organizational IT policies, standards and procedures. • Develops templates for designing IT standards and procedures for technical business plans. • Monitors the implementation of IT standards and procedures in IT projects or services. • Manages the process for IT standards and procedures delivery and implementation ensuring the organization is under effective management. • Revises IT policies, standards and procedures based on each department's feedback. Problem Management: Knowledge of the processes involved in problem control, error control and the production of management information or computer hardware; ability to identify the root cause of problems in a timely and accurate manner and bring them to a successful resolution. Level Extensive Experience: • Monitors and improves problem reporting, tracking, escalation and resolution. • Estimates costs and benefits of potential solutions and makes recommendations. • Receives, clarifies and resolves a variety of standard and atypical problems. • Conducts trend and root cause analysis to identify and address recurring problems. • Coaches junior staff on handling a variety of service related problems. • Identifies and evaluates alternative approaches to resolving service problems. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. Relocation assistance Holistic Development Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe Career developments opportunities with global prospects Health and Wellness Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage Employee mental wellness assistance program Financial Wellness Employee investment plan Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan. Additional Information: Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers Posting Dates: Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Role Definition: Design, development and testing of electronic control modules (ECM/ECU) for use within machines and engine systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Overseeing compliance with functional & environmental requirements, development processes, and regulations for ECM/ECUs. • Development of product requirements, analysis and simulation, electronic component selection, schematic/layout review, and platform verification and validation. • Collaboration with various levels of software as well as machine and engine systems teams to ensure the platform integrates into multiple applications. • Managing and negotiating with ECM/ECU vendors for the development of systems and components. • Investigating and troubleshooting all technical issues related to ECM/ECUs during development and through the production lifecycle. • Mentoring technicians and engineers in the development of electrical and electronic systems and components • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Electrical, Electronics curriculum. Degree Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in engineering from Tier 1 College and University. Master’s degree in Engineering will be a plus. Skill Descriptors: Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Extensive Experience: • Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching. • Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience. • Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position. • Communicates well downward, upward, and outward. • Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement. • Maintains focus on the topic at hand. Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Extensive Experience: • Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions. • Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues. • Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions. • Coaches others in promoting, defining, analyzing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems. • Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. • Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs. Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives. Level Working Knowledge: • Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status. • Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects. • Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements. • Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project. • Produces standard project status reports. Electronics Engineering
- HTH: Knowledge of electronics engineering; ability to design, test and manufacture electronic circuits, components and devices. Level Extensive Experience: • Trains others on designing complex integrated circuits. • Anticipates the challenges and opportunities associated with creating printed circuit boards. • Interprets alternative interfaces between hardware and software and associated requirements and considerations. • Advises on matching methodology, materials and tools to the electronic product that is being built. • Consults on engineering multiple electronic circuits, components or devices. • Evaluates the benefits and drawbacks of analog and digital circuits. Product Design
- HTH: Knowledge of and the ability to utilize design tools (e.g. CAD) to convert customer and market requirements into a product design. Level Extensive Experience: • Monitors each phase of the design procedure to ensure overall operation meets standards. • Trains others on major processes of product design; directs the conception of each component. • Advises others on the development of multiple products and their architectures. • Delivers improvement plans to senior management and compares the outcome of the design against the architecture. • Evaluates feedback from customers and consults on functional weaknesses. • Controls design and development costs of a proposed product through effective resource coordination. Reliability Management
- HTH: Knowledge of reliability management; ability to utilize various tools, techniques, methodologies and metrics to meet and manage hardware product performance and reliability objectives. Level Working Knowledge: • Selects appropriate tools and methods to ensure reliability expectations in hardware products. • Participates in product reliability and quality assurance standard processes to meet process demands. • Conducts performance and reliability testing for a specific hardware product or product group. • Implements reliability activities and tasks for product development and maintenance plans. • Analyzes common hardware reliability failures; provides corrective action plans. Mechanical Engineering
- MFG: Knowledge of mechanical engineering processes, techniques and methods; ability to design and implement machines and other mechanical devices that safely realize a desired objective or invention. Level Working Knowledge: • Works with basic, routine components of the mechanical engineering discipline in manufacturing. • Performs basic installation, testing, maintenance and repairs for machines, engines and other equipment. • Uses software to draft drawings or writes specifications for specific mechanical engineering projects. • Assists senior staff to resolve unusual mechanical problems; recommends ideas. • Follows relevant standards, policies and practices in mechanical engineering operations; reports violations. Supplier Management
- MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows procedures in carrying out routine supplier management tasks. • Uses electronic systems or tools to record/retrieve supplier information and carry out transactions with suppliers. • Resolves routine supplier issues; escalates non-routine issues up chain of command. • Researches alternative vendors or suppliers; participates in supplier selection. • Works with suppliers to ensure that purchases meet delivery date and quality specifications. Additional information: This job requires 5 working days from office. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Accounting Associate to join our team who will have the opportunity to champion us for GLBL BusSvcs India AP ITP team, Global Finance services Division. The incumbent would be expected to assists the finance and accounting department with payment and tracking of bills and invoices and reconciling conflicts. The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India What you will do Paying bills and invoices in accordance with established methods and procedures. Working with internal staff (purchasers) and external vendors and suppliers to clarify differences and reconcile conflicts. Following proper procedures and taking direction from senior staff; developing technical skills. Maintaining accurate records of all Accounts Payable transactions. What you will have Degree in accounting with at least 2+ years of accounting experience. The position requires the candidate to work 5- day -week schedule in the office and Flexibility to work in shifts including US Shift is required. Skills desired: Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge: • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights. • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs. • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy. • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned. • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge: • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation. Level Basic Understanding: • Explains basic concepts of time and priority management. • Seeks guidance in detecting and addressing priority conflicts. • States own business priorities. • Describes team or unit priorities. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge: • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives. • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder. • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information. • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution. • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems. Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Level Basic Understanding: • Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships. • Identifies key business relationships in own organization. • Describes the nature of a productive business relationship. • Explains the benefits of building business partnerships. Accounting: Knowledge of accounting methods, processes, and tools; ability to maintain and prepare financial statements and reports using accounting methods and processes. Level Basic Understanding: • Lists the major responsibilities of the accounting staff. • Explains the basic concepts and terminology of accounting. • Describes key activities of established accounting processes. • Identifies the basic tools used for maintaining accounting information. Accounts Payable (A-P): Knowledge of an organization's billing requirements; ability to utilize the proper tools and follow accounts payable practices and procedures. Level Basic Understanding: • Explains the basic concepts of accounts payable. • Summarizes basic accounts payable reports. • Initiates major types of accounts payable transactions. • Describes the basic steps and tools for maintaining accounts payable information. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. Relocation assistance Holistic Development Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe Career developments opportunities with global prospects Health and Wellness Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage Employee mental wellness assistance program Financial Wellness Employee investment plan Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan. Additional Information: Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply. Posting Dates: Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community. There’s more to work at Caterpillar than just the work itself. We hire smart, friendly people and it shows in our culture. We hold ourselves to high standards and make sure our values of integrity, excellence, teamwork, commitment and sustainability come to life in the way we work. We make sure our employees feel continuously challenged while also supported. We provide professional growth opportunities, including leadership programs. We celebrate the diversity of our team, while also working together as one Caterpillar. Our culture, like everything at our company, is made possible by each employee’s contribution. Person by person, we create the environment we work in, and we are proud of the Caterpillar we’ve built.

Job Summary We are looking to add a skilled Accounting Associate (Indirect Tax) within the Indirect Tax Co E (Centre of Excellence) based in Bangalore, India. This role is responsible for managing EMEA VAT compliance processes, leveraging technology platforms such as Vertex/Avalara to ensure accurate filings, data integrity, and payment workflows. The Associate will bring deep multi-jurisdictional tax knowledge, audit compliance expertise, and a proactive approach to process improvement and automation. The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India What you will do The indirect tax Co E will be responsible for the periodical indirect tax compliance for Global regions. This team will be responsible to extract and interpret the tax data from our systems to enable informed business decisions, perform return filing and reconciling with the books of accounts on the Tax positions. Our focus is on improving our tax processes by using technology, which increases our responsibility for monitoring the completeness and accuracy in our indirect tax systems, striving for full tax automation, and driving the vision for improved and efficient tax compliance. Our team consists of a diverse group of individuals with backgrounds across consulting, tax, accounting, and analytics. You will need to have strong project management skills as you'll drive cross-border projects and develop best practice in processes on a Global level. Maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders regarding compliance-related matters. Ensure adherence to indirect tax processes and update procedures as needed to reflect evolving business requirements. Prepare and review month-end reconciliations and journal entries, maintaining comprehensive audit documentation. Leverage technology to streamline and automate tax calculations, ensuring compliance and accuracy. Degree in finance, accounting, tax, or related field. Strong English written and verbal communication skills. Core experience with Global VAT/GST and Indirect tax accounting. Mainly UK Working knowledge of SAP and Tax engines, tools such as Vertex, GVRT, is preferred Robust knowledge of MS Excel Ability to analyse large data volumes to identify key insights. Role Definition: Develops, designs, implements and tests software of embedded devices and systems; monitors and enhances the efficiency and stability of the systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Gathering and analyzing user/client requirements to create the software requirements specification (SRS) document. • Writing and implementing source codes of embedded systems and enhancing code samples of existing systems. • Testing and debugging embedded system software using different tools/methods available to improve code quality and optimize system performance. • Collaborating with other teams to provide post production support. • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Degree Requirement: Degree required Skill Descriptors Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. Level Working Knowledge: • Describes common tools for component-based, object-oriented development. • Describes the objectives, activities and results of unit testing. • Has developed programs in a specific language and for a specific platform. • Interprets functional and technical blueprints; participates in structuring technical components. • Participates in technical and code reviews. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Basic Understanding: • Describes major components of system testing used by the organization. • Documents the standard processes and procedures involved in system testing. • Explains the importance of thorough system testing prior to implementation. • Identifies common errors that occur in standard system testing activities. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge: • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems. • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities. • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards. • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting. • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used. title: Controls Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. The Electrical engineer for Caterpillar Gas Turbine product will work on Electrical Schematics , Panel Layout or General Arrangement, Controls Design for Standard products, New Development , Custom feature development and aftermarket projects. The incumbent will be accountable for identifying and implementing actions to solve the necessary tasks to resolve product problems, develop new products, and advance turbomachinery technology. The incumbent will understand the business needs of development programs and uses these needs to balance the drive toward high technology and analytical perfection. Electrical Engineer provides electrical engineering solutions for projects and proposals and ensure that design and equipment meets customer specifications and industry codes and standards. Job

ROLE:
Responsible for Electrical design & maintenance for new production orders, aftermarket, new product development, retrofits, refurbishments, and upgrades to support varying configurations sold to the customer. Understanding Custom Order Requirement in Gas Turbines and Factory technicians Change requests and able to perform investigations in design based on root cause analysis, defining corrective actions for diversified products and custom features. Control System design, PLC programming for various PLC types using Ladder Logic or FBD programming techniques. Should understand and be able to direct the development of all Electrical Calculations including Short Circuit, Load Flow and Relay Coordination. Will handle specification creation and modification, scope drawings creation and review of equipment specifications (Fuel system, Lubrication, Fire & Gas Protection, Vibration Monitoring, Auxiliary Systems Control, BOP, Generator, etc). Scope drawings include, among others, high, medium and low voltage One Line diagrams, Area classification, block diagrams, power and control cable raceways, grounding, lightning, and cable schedules. HV. MV and LV applications are directly related to power generation packages, and power supply to Gas compressor installations. Designs and specifies electrical equipment as found commonly in the Oil & Gas environment. · Participates in project design reviews, and HAZOP reviews. Interface with multi discipline teams during the definition of equipment scope and throughout project execution. Assists in design of electrical system operating logic. Develop effective engineering solutions to assigned tasks that meet Company/program objective while minimizing the expenditure of resources Identity potential problems, surface technical issues, and act accordingly Perform as an effective team member in cross-functional teams and act in a professional manner to drive toward consensus Identity business and technical needs to enhance the competitive position of the Company and contribute to the actions required to satisfy these needs
minimumQualification: · Bachelor / Master of Science Degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent with 8-12 years of experience for Bachelors degree and 5-8 years’ experience with master’s degree preferably in Oil and Gas industry. · Design and Commissioning experience in Gas turbines or any Power generation Industry or Industrial Automation area. · Experience in PLC Hardware and Software (Allen Bradley & RsLogix Ladder Logic is added advantage) · Experience in Windchill (or equivalent) product life cycle management · Conversant with E-Cad drafting software Promis-e , E Plan , Auto CAD or Similar advanced Software’s and familiarity in ANSI/IEC standards · Demonstrated proficiency in problem solving and troubleshooting. · Effective communication skills, both written and oral, in the English language. · Sense of urgency and good organizational skills are required to work with multiple projects and competing priorities.
